name: Customer Complaint
description: A payment-related customer complaint record tracking issue type, amount, resolution, and timestamps.

name: Payment Transaction
description: A single payment transaction recorded in the POS system.

name: UPI Transaction Report
description: Central record of Unified Payments Interface transactions processed through a Payment Service Provider

name: UPI Refund
description: A single refund transaction record for UPI payments

name: UPI Settlement
description: Represents a Unified Payments Interface settlement record with transaction and financial details.

name: Daily Sales
description: A single sales transaction record captured each day.

name: Forecast Plan
description: A single forecasting/planning record for inventory and replenishment.

name: Goods Receipt
description: A single business entity representing the receipt of goods, tracking identifiers, quantities, SKUs, and validation methods.

name: Shipment
description: Core logistics record for a single shipment entity.

name: Inventory Book
description: Represents inventory records with snapshot dates, product SKUs, and on-hand quantities.

name: POS Line Item
description: Represents an individual line item within a point-of-sale bill.

name: Product Information
description: Core product master data for inventory and supply chain management

name: Shelf Audit
description: Represents a single inventory audit record for a shelf location.

name: Stock Count
description: Represents a single inventory counting event tracking planned vs actual quantities.

name: Store Order
description: Represents a single order record in the store system.

name: Pick Confirmation
description: A single record confirming that a line item has been picked and confirmed in a sales order.

name: Stock Adjustment
description: Represents inventory or cost adjustments recorded in the system.
